target_customer: Consulting firms, corporates and organizations that want to learn how employees work
problem: Companies do not know how work actually gets done, and interviews and surveys are slow and shallow.
business_model: B2B SaaS and project-based pricing, demo-led (prices not published)

founders.name: Madeleine Malmsten
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as ex principal engineer at McKinsey and QuantumBlack.

competitors.name: Outset
competitors.what: AI moderated voice and video interviews for customer research

technical_complexity.rationale: Multilingual voice interviewing with multi-agent coding of statements is standard applied AI with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Customer-research voice interview tools already exist and the method is copyable; consulting relationships may help.

market_need_then: Consulting and transformation work needs process discovery; founders came from BCG and McKinsey and report a large consulting firm as a customer (self-reported).

identity.visual_style: Portrait photos and short quotes; has a /design brand page not read
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, outcome focused; tagline Listen & move forward

brand_strength.rationale: Name with a numeral is distinctive but easily confused with other Sona brands; no third-party brand coverage.

pivots.from: Voice agents surveying employees about their work
pivots.to: Workflow capture and automation via conversations, screen shares and recordings
pivots.why: YC launch posts show a newer launch with broader capture; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Sona8 is an active Fall 2026 company founded by former BCG and McKinsey people, with named customers on its site and no exit or shutdown found. It sells into consulting-led workflow discovery, a space with funded voice-interview competitors, so the outcome is too early to read.
notes: Funding conflicts: Trending Topics, startbase and inforcapital say YC plus angels and over $500,000 total; Dealroom says about $125K; a tech.eu 500k pre-seed record was not tied to Sona8. Not recorded as a round. Name origin not found. Outset date is a Product Hunt listing from 2023, older than the batch.
